camera.motion: static (background identical in all frames; median-background differencing leaves no residue outside the block)
camera.view: side view, roughly fronto-parallel to the ramp; horizon/wall-floor line at y~900 (horizontal); slight perspective on tatami floor lines and on the stand box top

pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

block.desc: small white/cream rounded rectangular block (soap-bar-like) sliding down the channel on top of the inclined wooden ramp; the only moving object
block.visible_frames: 0-44 (40-41 mostly hidden behind ramp lip, 42 partial, 44 mostly out of frame bottom)

pixel_size_sliding_frames_0_38.note: lower edge of block may be slightly hidden by the channel wall; length is the reliable dimension

ramp.desc: large inclined wooden (reddish-brown) ramp/board with a grey channel on top, high end at right, low end at left
ramp.note: slope extends to lower-left; block path is a straight line at the fitted angle

stand_box.desc: light beige box/stand under the ramp with black open top
stand_box.note: lower part cut by frame edge; partly hidden by ramp

hanging_scroll.desc: calligraphy hanging scroll on the back wall (three large black characters)

tatami_floor.desc: tatami mats with dark borders, y>900

events.name: block at rest at top of ramp
start of sliding (first visible displacement)
events.note: s=0.9px at f2, 2.6px at f3; motion begins ~f1-2 from rest

events.name: block reaches the lower-left lip and passes behind it
block leaves ramp, falls (projectile) toward floor

duplicate_frames.note: the encoded video repeats some frames (every ~3-12 frames). Per-frame differences at those frames are 0 and the following step is doubled. Fit s(t) over all frames or skip duplicates when fitting motion.
